analysis:
Both changed files are test-only. MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineTests.swift (head lines 625-634) adds a unit test for ModelEOSPolicy.stopStringScope, covering the GPT-OSS Harmony final-channel scope: opener "<|channel|>final", openerEnd "<|message|>", closers end/return/call/start. It also covers detection by modelType gpt_oss, and nil for gemma and qwen. The test adds no runtime code, no new inputs, and no changes to trust boundaries, keys, attestation, or the cache. GemmaToolCallLiveTests.swift line 264 changes a switch case from `.info` to `.info, .logprobs`, ignoring a new logprobs event in a live test. It does not alter production behavior.

The tests imply production changes elsewhere in the PR that are outside this batch: a stop-string scoping feature (CBv2StopStringScope) and a logprobs event. Those production changes might affect TB-007 and T-041, for example whether logprobs could leak prompt-derived information or whether stop-string scoping changes output handling. I could not assess those because the source files are not supplied. The next review pass should examine the production implementation of stopStringScope and the logprobs streaming path. In particular it should check whether logprobs are returned over the sealed channel and whether they are encrypted like other response chunks (T-008). No regression is identifiable from these test-only changes.
